series.name: The AI Ask
series.line: What Irish marketing and sales job ads ask for about AI, every quarter.
series.method: Every marketing and sales job ad on seven Irish sources on one day, read by an agent and judged by one rulebook.

series.name: GEO Ireland
series.line: Who five AI engines name when people ask Irish questions, category by category.
series.method: The same questions, 41 categories of Irish life, put to five AI engines, every name counted.

series.name: The State of AI in Irish Marketing
series.line: What Irish marketing teams do with AI, measured from what they do, not what they say.
series.method: A panel of Irish marketing leads, asked the same questions every six months, with the answers checked against their own job ads and websites.

series.name: Agent Economics
series.line: What a marketing agent costs to build and run, from the agents we run ourselves.
series.method: Our own agent team's bills, run logs and hours saved, every task counted, six months at a time.

series.name: Irish Ads by Sector
series.line: What each Irish sector ran on Meta and Google this quarter, and what changed.
series.method: Every active ad from Irish advertisers in the Meta and Google ad libraries, pulled on one day per quarter and sorted by sector and format.

series.name: The Irish Marketing Team
series.line: How Irish marketing teams are built: size, roles, pay, and what AI has changed.
series.method: Job ads, public team pages and a panel of heads of marketing, read once a year.

series.name: AI Overviews in Ireland
series.line: How often Google answers an Irish search with AI before anyone clicks, sector by sector.
series.method: A fixed set of Irish searches per sector, run from an Irish address, the AI answer and its sources recorded.

series.name: The Boardroom Pulse
series.line: What Irish chief executives and marketing directors plan to spend on AI, and what they fear.
series.method: A panel of Irish CEOs, CFOs and marketing directors, the same eight questions every six months.

series.name: The Creative Audit
series.line: AI-made ads against people-made ads, scored the same way, every quarter.
series.method: A sample of Irish ads scored for distinctive assets, branding in the first two seconds and one clear message, blind to who made them.

series.name: Small Firms and AI
series.line: How Irish firms with under 50 people use AI in sales and marketing.
series.method: A panel of Irish firms with under 50 staff, by county and sector, asked what they use and what they pay.

series.name: The Mystery Shop
series.line: The same question put to the chat, email and phone of Irish firms, and how fast and how well they answer.
series.method: An agent sends the same customer question to each firm's website chat, email and phone, and scores the reply for speed and for whether it answered.

series.name: The Irish Martech Index
series.line: Which marketing tools Irish firms run, read from their websites and job ads.
series.method: The tools found on Irish firms' websites and named in their job ads, counted by category.
